scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && esbuild src/feed.ts --platform=node --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/feed/index.js && esbuild src/events.ts --platform=node --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/events/index.js && esbuild src/manifest.ts --platform=node --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/manifest/index.js && esbuild src/trendingWriter.ts --platform=node --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/trending-writer/index.js
scripts.pack: npm run build && (cd dist/feed && zip -r ../feed.zip .) && (cd dist/events && zip -r ../events.zip .) && (cd dist/manifest && zip -r ../manifest.zip .) && (cd dist/trending-writer && zip -r ../trending-writer.zip .)
